EDTA4- is a hexadentate ligand containing four negative charges on its corner oxygen atoms as follows :

 

Being a hexadentate ligand, it forms a ring like structure through chelation.

 

 

 

The central metal ion Co is in the centre, coordinated to the two N atoms and the four O- ions through chelation. Now, if we observe, we see that each N atom forms four N - Co - O bonds with the four O- ions.
